operations.why: The v2225 codec inherits a one-byte action selector: STOP_VIDEO_CAPTURE is 0 and START_VIDEO_CAPTURE is 1, followed by frame rate and file prefix. The same values and framing are used by gophertunnel at 8c30047d86617a56e1f1871e3a1d47ec4f670d99.
